skater.name: Sniper
skater.description: Shoots harder and straighter than he does anything else.

skater.name: Playmaker
skater.description: Quick, accurate passes; hard to take the puck from.

skater.name: Speedster
skater.description: The fastest skater on the ice.

skater.name: Enforcer
skater.description: Wins the puck with his body and never tires.

skater.name: Two-way
skater.description: No weakness and no one great strength.

goalie.name: Reflex goalie
goalie.description: Reacts and moves across fast; covers less net standing still.

goalie.name: Positional goalie
goalie.description: Fills the net and cuts the angle; slower to react.
